appIds.title: App IDs
appIds.description: Numeric App Store track IDs (e.g. 284882215 for Facebook). Digits from the App Store URL after /id.

appUrls.title: App Store URLs
appUrls.description: Paste full App Store links like https://apps.apple.com/us/app/facebook/id284882215 — country + id are parsed automatically.

search.title: Search term
search.description: Optional iTunes software search (entity=software). Hits are added to the app list. Empty = skip search.

countries.title: Storefront countries
countries.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 storefront codes (us, gb, de, …). Reviews are fetched per app × country. Cap 500 reviews each.

maxPages.title: Max RSS pages per app/country
maxPages.description: 1–10. Each page has up to 50 reviews. Apple hard-caps at page 10 (~500 reviews per app per country).

includeAppDetails.title: Include app lookup details
includeAppDetails.description: If true, call itunes lookup for each app/country and store results in key-value record APPS (not the reviews dataset).
